correctness.rationale: Each five-vertex out-neighborhood is x+R, R={1,3,4,5,9} modulo 11. Exhaustive independent face construction found (11,55,110,55,11), 242 nonempty faces. Independent reproducible elementary-collapse matching yielded exactly 110 face-coface pairs and 22 critical cells (one vertex, 21 triangles); reversing match edges in all 715 Hasse incidences gave acyclic directed graph with all 242 nodes topologically sorted. This gives the integral wedge of 21 two-spheres. Signed Lefschetz checks of all 55 affine symmetries yield (21,-1,1), the character of 1+2 Aug(Q[11]); quotient rational H2 rank 1 follows by averaging.
